observations: Multiple boxes of EverExceed Tall Tubular Batteries stacked together.
The model number EXT 22000 is clearly printed on the front of the boxes in photo 0.
The boxes appear to be factory-strapped and wrapped in clear plastic.
A watermark 'CHIDON GLOBAL TOOLS' is visible across the center of the image.
Text on the box indicates 'Inside Calcium', 'Selenium Inside', and 'Low Maintenance'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a large quantity of boxed batteries.

claims.claim: all solar panels and inverters are available
claims.evidence: The photo only shows batteries; no panels or inverters are visible.

risks.risk: The batteries may be counterfeit or the boxes may contain different, lower-quality units.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery itself out of the box, showing the engraved or printed serial number and specifications on the casing.

risks.risk: The batteries may be old stock with degraded capacity or internal shorts (dead on arrival).
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the resting voltage (should be >12.6V) and a load test.

proof_requests: Photo of the battery outside the box showing the top terminals and the manufacturer's label.
Video of a voltage test using a multimeter.
Photo of the manufacturing date stamp usually found on the battery casing or terminals.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identifiable from the packaging. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (scrap/non-working) until performance is proven.
